items.title: She claims to be helping children around the world, but is it real?
items.description: Receiving millions of views online, the Lily Jay Foundation claims to help children across the world. She was even given an award for her work. But what is real and what is AI-generated? ABC NEWS Verify investigates.

items.title: Before her alleged murder, Tunchanok Donhomla smiled through 'tough life'
items.description: While the public will remember Thai teenager Tunchanok Donhomla for the tragic nature of her death, her aunt, Mee Boonsert, will remember the baby she helped raise.

items.title: Dentists see complications as Australians travel overseas for treatments
items.description: Janelle Jeal thought having dental care overseas would be life changing. It was, but for the wrong reasons.

items.title: Australia's spy agency turns to Vogue to find recruits
items.description: A security industry insider tells the ABC the agency cannot afford to "just hire dweebs" as ASIS pivots to a new recruitment strategy aimed at women.

items.title: How many gambling ads played during the Socceroos match?
items.description: There should be rules against jumping on the World Cup bandwagon to illustrate a political point, but the Socceroos' valiant effort against Egypt offers a timely real-world test.

items.title: The Trump era echoes the messy truth behind the founding of America
items.description: US Independence Day was never the simple morality tale Americans often tell themselves. Under Donald Trump the debate over its meaning is more politically charged than ever under.

items.title: Investors consider class action over super scam
items.description: Investors who lost out in a superannuation scam are considering a potential class action.

items.title: 'The world lost him': Crowds gather in Iran to farewell body of assassinated supreme leader
items.description: Millions of Iranians have gathered in Tehran as the country begins a week of funeral ceremonies for former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: The golden rule that's guided Play School for 60 years
items.description: Australian Story is given rare behind-the-scenes access to Play School as it celebrates 60 years on air. An intimate look at the creative process of the iconic children’s TV show that’s still guided by one golden rule.

items.title: Taylor Swift's 'royal wedding' was a lesson in media 'mastery'
items.description: After mounting speculation, Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have officially tied the knot. One expert says what we know, and don't know, about the wedding is a lesson in "media mastery".

items.title: Bird flu threatens to devastate seabird population on Great Barrier Reef
items.description: A vulnerable colony of red-tailed tropic birds is being monitored for the deadly H5 bird flu, with fears the impact on Australian native bird populations could be significant.

items.title: How NAIDOC grew from a one-day protest to a week-long celebration
items.description: Traditionally, NAIDOC Week was celebrated by First Nations people, but it has become an invitation for non-Indigenous Australians to get involved.

items.title: Live: Tempers rise as temperature rises Paraguay frustrates France
items.description: Surprise-packets Paraguay take on hot-favourites France, Morocco marches into World Cup quarterfinals with 3-0 win over Canada. Follow live.

items.title: 'Dismantled from the inside out': Finding connection after child loss
items.description: After Kimberly Stevens lost her teenage son she spent years building an app to help other bereaved parents, and she is now taking its findings to an international audience.

items.title: App fatigue can 'warp' dating but there's an antidote
items.description: Dating apps promised more choice than ever, but experts say the endless swiping and split-second decisions may be leaving users more exhausted, and less connected, than before. But deleting them may not be the only solution.

items.title: It's time for your weekly spelling check-up
items.description: Will those primary school spelling sheets be enough to pull you a pass?

items.title: Meet the desert kids making classic hard rock cool again
items.description: Inspired by AC/DC and raised in a remote NT community, these young cousins have become one of Australia's most unlikely hard rock bands.

items.title: Gold treasure, an engraved turtle shell and the shipwreck that went missing
items.description: The startling noise of metal on metal was unusual on a coral reef and unlocked a nearly century-old mystery of a tragic maritime disaster, sunken treasure and a peculiar, inscribed turtle shell.

items.title: Japan releases LGBTQIA+ education plan but some are not happy
items.description: The first national plan of its kind is broadly criticised by gay rights proponents and legal experts for supporting the status quo.

items.title: Sydney Trains female apprentices step up amid local labour target
items.description: Nicola Huggins and Ariana Gackowski are learning the wiring, welding and hand tool skills required to one day repair the trains Sydneysiders travel on every day.

items.title: Broken back prompts apprentice electrician to chase footy career
items.description: Rather than ending his promising sporting prospects, a fractured back has prompted Mount Gambier tall Jobe Janeway to chase his dream of playing in the AFL.

items.title: Icy poles and ice baths as Vingegaard claims yellow
items.description: Jonas Vingegaard leads the Tour de France after being delivered to victory in the opening state team time trial by his Visma lease-a-bike squad on the streets of Barcelona.

items.title: Tears flow as 21yo Filipino stuns reigning champion at Wimbledon
items.description: Alexandra Eala is left in tears after her stunning victory over reigning Wimbledon champion Iga Świątek.

items.title: Footballer critical after sustaining head injury during match
items.description: A 27-year-old player is in a critical condition after a serious mid-match injury during a football game in Lalor this afternoon.

items.title: Ukraine retaliates, striking St Petersburg following deadliest attack
items.description: Ukraine has retaliated after Russia's attack on Kyiv killed at least 27 people.
